newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Front page carries the full text of an October, 1996 decision by the Central Committee of the Communist Party and the State Council to make the eradication of poverty a key task.
China plans to draw $49.5 billion of direct overseas investment in 1997, up 15 percent from last year.
The Guizhou Aluminium Plant plans to produce 150,000 tonnes of aluminium in 1997, generating sales of 2.0 billion yuan ($241 million).

Pre-tax profits of the machine-building industry are estimated to have been 29 billion yuan ($3.5 billion) in 1996, down 14 percent from the year before. Output of the sector was about 450 billion yuan ($54.2 billion) last year, up 10 percent from 1995.
China will step up reform of the pharmaceutical industry and tighten examination of new pharmaceutical projects.
